但他本身就身受重伤，再加上为了帮助苦艾将灵魂放生，并为文明长阶布置后手，也是到了崩溃的边缘。
“这难道是睡前幻觉？不……不对 ……”'渊’只是愣神一瞬，就立刻充满警觉。
他第一反应就是自己不知不觉间，中了血腥主宰的算计，被他影响了。
“我知道你有很多疑惑，说实话我也不清楚到底发生了什么事情，但你的回归要感谢一个人，那就是文明长阶现在的领袖，是他将你带回来的。”
于渊看着‘渊’笑着说道：“你好‘渊’，我就是获得【神秘主义者】天赋和【神之侧身像】称号路径的人，你的安排奏效了。”
“难怪，难怪我感觉你的气息有些变化。原来是这样……”随即想到什么，脸色微变。
‘渊’虽然已经是准神话级的存在，但听到于渊的话， 还是有些没反应过来。

But he himself was seriously injured, and in order to help Wu Mie release his soul and arrange a back-up for the civilization leaders, he was on the verge of collapse.
"Is this a hallucination before sleeping? No...no..." 'Yuan' was just stunned for a moment, and immediately became alert.
His first reaction was that he had unknowingly fallen into the bloody master's plan and been influenced by him.
"I know you have a lot of doubts, and to be honest, I don't know what happened, but you have one person to thank for your return, and that is the current leader of the Civilization Leader, who brought you back."
Yu Yuan looked at 'Yuan' and said with a smile: "Hello 'Yuan', I am the person who has obtained the talent of [Mystic] and the path to the title of [Silent Image of God]. Your arrangement worked."
"No wonder, no wonder I feel some changes in your breath. So it's like this..." Then he thought of something and his face changed slightly.
Although 'Yuan' is already a quasi-mythical existence, he still didn't react when he heard Yu Yuan's words.
